    Sentinel Light · DIRKS prototype 0.2 · Governance and execution are simulated here.
    DOER + CLICKS

    A clear path from intent to outcome.

    1. You ask. Sentinel Light captures and clarifies the task.
    2. DIRKS prepares. A bounded capability builds a reviewable plan.
    3. You decide. Sentinel governance checks and your approval would guard live execution.
    4. You see the result. SentinelOS would coordinate the dock and reconcile provider evidence.

    This prototype simulates that lifecycle locally. It has no live Sentinel AI, SentinelOS, grocery, banking, or voice connection.
